reason: My NRO balance is small, under 5 lakh, and I would rather do it through my own Indian bank on my next trip. I do not know this company and I do not hand my savings to a new outfit I just saw online.

would_change_my_mind: My own Indian bank or my Canadian bank recommending or offering this service, so a name I already trust is handling the money.
